rejected.why: Scene 21 depicts the physical collapse and breakdown of the Machine, but none of its beats reference, depend upon, or collect Kuno's earlier warning to Vashti.
The beats for scene 11 only show Kuno reaching the surface, breathing air, and looking at the hills; they do not establish him encountering living surface dwellers.

accepted.why: a passenger drops his Book and Vashti accidentally treads on it as they board
Kuno informs Vashti that the Machine is stopping
the Committee of the Mending Apparatus promises that mechanical defects will be remedied shortly
Kuno is relocated underground into the same orbit and region as Vashti.
